title: *Independent and Canadian references for checking a drug choice against the AI's suggestion or your own: monographs, comparison charts, safety alerts, shortages and dosing calculators. Coverage is on [Drug Coverage](Drug%20Coverage.md).*

heading: Key Sources
title: Therapeutics Initiative - Therapeutics Letter (UBC)
note: independent, bimonthly reviews of drug therapy questions, published since 1994; free

heading: Key Sources
title: Canadian Pharmacists Association - CPS (Compendium of Pharmaceuticals and Specialties)
note: Canadian drug monographs and therapeutic information* · *subscription

heading: Key Sources
title: RxFiles - Drug Comparison Charts, 15th edition
note: side-by-side drug comparisons by system, from University of Saskatchewan academic detailing; some charts and the app need a subscription

heading: Monographs and Product Information
title: Health Canada - Drug Product Database
note: every drug authorized for sale in Canada, with its product monograph and marketing status; updated nightly

heading: Monographs and Product Information
title: Canada's Drug Agency (CDA-AMC) - Find Reports
note: reimbursement reviews and recommendations that inform public drug plans, including PharmaCare

heading: Safety and Supply
title: BC PharmaCare - Drug shortages
note: current shortages at BC community pharmacies, with covered alternatives and coverage notes

heading: Safety and Supply
title: Health Canada - MedEffect Canada
note: report an adverse reaction and find new drug safety information

heading: Safety and Supply
title: Government of Canada - Recalls and safety alerts

heading: Safety and Supply
title: ISMP Canada
note: safety bulletins, including the "Do Not Use" list of dangerous abbreviations

heading: Safety and Supply
title: Health Canada - Drug shortages in Canada
note: national shortage and discontinuation reports from manufacturers

heading: Safety and Supply
title: Drug and health product shortages reporting site

heading: Dosing Calculators
title: Thrombosis Canada - Creatinine Clearance (Cockcroft-Gault Equation)
note: for renal dose adjustment; serum creatinine in µmol/L

heading: Dosing Calculators
title: - Opioid morphine milligram equivalents (MME) — *see [Opioids, Controlled Drugs and Substance Use](Opioids%20Controlled%20Drugs%20and%20Substance%20Use.md#dosing-calculators)*

heading: Special Populations
title: RxFiles - Geri-RxFiles (4th edition)
note: Canadian guide to assessing medicines in older adults: frailty, drug therapy in the older adult, deprescribing algorithms and medicine charts by body system; most chapters need a subscription
keywords: Geri-RxFiles, GeriRxFiles, RxFiles geriatrics, older adults medications, elderly drug reference
